load_image_data: load all image data including rgb, depth, camera, gt, and masks from a bop-imagewise dataset directory
save_scene_camera: save scene camera annotations from a BOP-scenewise dict to individual per-image JSON files
save_scene_gt: save scene ground truth annotations from a BOP-scenewise dict to individual per-image JSON files
save_masks: save object masks as RLE-encoded JSON by converting a list of binary numpy arrays to a JSON file
load_image_infos: parse a bop-imagewise dataset directory to check which annotation files exist for a given image key
